title: nf-core/gwasqc pipeline - params.reference_panel schema
description: Schema for the reference panel samplesheet provided with params.reference_panel. One row declares one PLINK 1 bed/bim/fam fileset of the reference panel: either a single whole-genome fileset or one fileset per chromosome; the rows are merged into one reference per stratum.

id.description: Unique identifier of the fileset, such as a chromosome or `all`; used as the prefix of the per-fileset intersect and as the merge order.
id.errorMessage: Reference fileset id must be provided, must be unique across the samplesheet and cannot contain spaces

bed.description: PLINK 1 binary genotype file of the reference fileset; must share its basename with the bim and fam files.
bed.errorMessage: PLINK 1 genotype file must be provided, must exist, cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.bed'

bim.description: PLINK 1 extended MAP file accompanying the bed file.
bim.errorMessage: PLINK 1 variant file must be provided, must exist, cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.bim'

fam.description: PLINK 1 sample information file accompanying the bed file.
fam.errorMessage: PLINK 1 sample file must be provided, must exist, cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fam'
